name: admin_quota_definition
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk quota definition — a spend/token limit (with a buffer) applied over a daily or monthly period, which quota mappings then bind to platform or workspace scopes.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Period the quota applies over. Defaults to 'Daily'.

attributes.name: limit_usd
attributes.description: Spend limit in USD for the period. Must be at least 0.01.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the quota definition.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Whether the quota definition is active. Defaults to active when omitted.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created the quota definition.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last updated the quota definition.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the quota definition was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the quota definition was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
